name: Sears Tower
description: Sears Tower: Located in Chicago, USA, it is 442.3 meters high, with 110 floors above ground and 3 floors underground. When it was completed in 1974, it surpassed the World Trade Center in New York and became the tallest building in the world at that time. In July 2009, it was renamed Willis Group Building. The shape of the building is like nine square hollow tubes of different heights gathered together. It is tall and neat, simple and stable. The facades in different directions have different shapes. The tube structure system is the result of the combination of architectural design and structural innovation.
